Callout.Name: Fire at a Remote Property
Callout.Message: Fire at an outbuilding on a remote property.
Callout.Advisory: No persons seen, smoke visible from the road.

Script.Line: It is the outbuilding, and there is a still in it and it is burning.
It has taken the roof and there is a propane tank against the wall.
Nobody is in there. Nobody has been in there tonight.

Lines.Approach: Smoke you can see from the highway and nobody answering. It could be the still going up.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
